_comment: Cumshot NG - SexLab P+. Read once per game load.
The ejaculation is drawn when the actor's penis is OUTSIDE a partner (handjob, footjob,
boobjob, shaft licking, facial, grinding, or the actor is simply the one being penetrated)
and hidden when it is INSIDE one. 'internal' lists what counts as inside; set a value to 0
to spray for that interaction anyway.
vaginal / anal    the actor penetrates a vagina / an anus
deepthroat        the actor's penis is deep in a partner's mouth
skullfuck         the actor penetrates a partner's head
oral              the actor's crotch is being sucked (blowjob, 69) - 1 = hidden
grinding          crotch grinding against a partner's body - 0 = drawn
hideWithoutData: 1 = hide the ejaculation when SexLab P+ has no real collision data for the
scene (typically creature scenes: P+ then reports a placeholder). 0 = draw it anyway.
creatureStrict: 1 = in scenes with a creature, draw it only when SexLab P+ clearly reports a
handjob / footjob / boobjob / shaft licking / facial; anything less clear is hidden.
animation: 1 = the penis pulses while the cum is drawn (TNG / SOS custom animation slot 0).
requireContact: 1 = only draw when the penis is actually engaged with a partner.
minOrgasmGap: seconds of real time before the same actor may ejaculate again.
log: 1 = write every decision to Data/SKSE/Plugins/Cumshot_PPlus.log.
hybridProjectiles: 1 = in Particles mode also fire invisible projectiles in time with the spurts,
so the splash puddles and sounds of the Projectiles mode appear. Needs Cumshot - Particles Hybrid.esp.
